Test Case 4: Redis Resource Allocation Validation

Input: Check redis local values configuration

Expected Output:
- Redis memory request: 512Mi (not 6Gi)
- Redis persistence size: 8Gi (not 32Gi)
- File: charts/redis/values/local.redis.values.yaml

Validation:
- Redis resources must be compatible with docker-desktop defaults (2-4Gi total)
- 6Gi memory request would cause pod to be unschedulable
- 512Mi is sufficient for local development and testing
- 8Gi storage is appropriate for local workloads
- Verifies enforcement task completed successfully
